'''2014 MPC Holotable Kevin Shannon DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Holotable).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire|VB8-D-wookieeslavingoperation-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Holotable
